description: Encode and decode the Rail Fence transposition cipher with 2–10 rails.

faqs.a: Text is written in a zigzag across N rails and read row by row. Decoding rebuilds the zigzag pattern to reverse it.
faqs.q: How does the Rail Fence cipher work?

faqs.a: More rails means more mixing, but any rail count 2–10 decodes perfectly with the same setting.
faqs.q: Which rail count should I use?

faqs.a: Spaces and punctuation are kept — decoding restores them to their exact positions.

title: Rail Fence Cipher Tool
